title: The different uses of the verb 'get' - Get + adjectives, prepositions

options.answer: I get tired after work every day.
I get tire after work every day.
I get tiredly after work every day.

explanation.en: After 'get', we use adjectives, not verbs or adverbs. 'Get tired' means to become tired.
explanation.ru: После 'get' мы используем прилагательные, а не глаголы или наречия. 'Get tired' означает устать.
explanation.uz: 'Get' dan keyin sifatlar ishlatiladi, fe'llar yoki ravishlar emas. 'Get tired' charchash ma'nosini bildiradi.

options.answer: She gets on the bus at 8 AM.
She gets in the bus at 8 AM.
She gets to the bus at 8 AM.

explanation.en: We use 'get on' with public transport like buses and trains. 'Get in' is for cars, and 'get to' means arrive.
explanation.ru: Мы используем 'get on' с общественным транспортом, как автобусы и поезда. 'Get in' для машин, а 'get to' означает прибыть.
explanation.uz: Jamoat transporti (avtobus, poyezd) uchun 'get on' ishlatiladi. 'Get in' mashinalar uchun, 'get to' esa yetib borish ma'nosini bildiradi.

options.answer: The weather is getting cold in winter.
The weather is getting coldly in winter.
The weather gets cold in winter.

explanation.en: Both 'get' and 'getting' work with adjectives, but for general facts we use simple present 'gets'. We don't use adverbs like 'coldly'.
explanation.ru: И 'get', и 'getting' работают с прилагательными, но для общих фактов мы используем простое настоящее 'gets'. Мы не используем наречия как 'coldly'.
explanation.uz: 'Get' va 'getting' ikkalasi ham sifatlar bilan ishlaydi, lekin umumiy faktlar uchun oddiy hozirgi zamon 'gets' ishlatiladi. 'Coldly' kabi ravishlar ishlatilmaydi.

options.answer: I need to get up early tomorrow.
I need to get off early tomorrow.
I need to get out early tomorrow.

explanation.en: All three are correct but mean different things. 'Get out' means leave a place, 'get up' means wake up, 'get off' means leave transport.
explanation.ru: Все три правильные, но означают разное. 'Get out' означает покинуть место, 'get up' проснуться, 'get off' сойти с транспорта.
explanation.uz: Uchala gap ham to'g'ri, lekin har xil ma'noni bildiradi. 'Get out' joyni tark etish, 'get up' uyg'onish, 'get off' transportdan tushish ma'nosini bildiradi.

options.answer: My grandmother is getting older every year.
My grandmother gets old every year.
My grandmother is getting old.

explanation.en: 'Getting old' shows a gradual process happening now. 'Getting older' is also correct but 'getting old' is more natural for this meaning.
explanation.ru: 'Getting old' показывает постепенный процесс, происходящий сейчас. 'Getting older' тоже правильно, но 'getting old' более естественно для этого значения.
explanation.uz: 'Getting old' hozir sodir bo'layotgan bosqichma-bosqich jarayonni ko'rsatadi. 'Getting older' ham to'g'ri, lekin 'getting old' bu ma'no uchun tabiiiroq.

options.answer: I get angry when people are late.
I get angrily when people are late.
I get anger when people are late.

explanation.en: 'Get' is followed by adjectives like 'angry', not adverbs like 'angrily' or nouns like 'anger'.
explanation.ru: После 'get' идут прилагательные как 'angry', а не наречия как 'angrily' или существительные как 'anger'.
explanation.uz: 'Get' dan keyin 'angry' kabi sifatlar keladi, 'angrily' kabi ravishlar yoki 'anger' kabi otlar emas.

options.answer: Can you get me some water from the kitchen?
Can you get to me some water from the kitchen?
Can you get for me some water from the kitchen?

explanation.en: When 'get' means obtain something for someone, we use the pattern 'get someone something' or 'get something for someone'.
explanation.ru: Когда 'get' означает получить что-то для кого-то, мы используем модель 'get someone something' или 'get something for someone'.
explanation.uz: 'Get' kimgadir nimadir olish ma'nosida bo'lganda, 'get someone something' yoki 'get something for someone' modelini ishlatamiz.

options.answer: The children get excited about Christmas.
The children get excitement about Christmas.
The children get excitedly about Christmas.

explanation.en: 'Get excited' uses the adjective form. We say 'get excited about' something, not 'get excitement' or 'get excitedly'.
explanation.ru: 'Get excited' использует форму прилагательного. Мы говорим 'get excited about' что-то, а не 'get excitement' или 'get excitedly'.
explanation.uz: 'Get excited' sifat shaklini ishlatadi. Nimadir haqida 'get excited about' deb aytamiz, 'get excitement' yoki 'get excitedly' emas.

options.answer: We got to the station just in time.
We got at the station just in time.
We got on the station just in time.

explanation.en: 'Get to' means arrive at a place. 'Get on' is for boarding transport, and 'get at' has different meanings but not for arriving.
explanation.ru: 'Get to' означает прибыть в место. 'Get on' для посадки на транспорт, а 'get at' имеет другие значения, но не для прибытия.
explanation.uz: 'Get to' joyga yetib borish ma'nosini bildiradi. 'Get on' transportga chiqish uchun, 'get at' esa boshqa ma'nolarni bildiradi, lekin yetib borish uchun emas.

options.answer: It's getting dark outside.
It's getting darkly outside.
It's getting darkness outside.

explanation.en: 'Getting dark' uses the adjective 'dark' to show a gradual change. We don't use 'darkly' (adverb) or 'darkness' (noun) here.
explanation.ru: 'Getting dark' использует прилагательное 'dark' для показа постепенного изменения. Мы не используем 'darkly' (наречие) или 'darkness' (существительное) здесь.
explanation.uz: 'Getting dark' bosqichma-bosqich o'zgarishni ko'rsatish uchun 'dark' sifatini ishlatadi. Bu yerda 'darkly' (ravish) yoki 'darkness' (ot) ishlatilmaydi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: The weather is getting ___ in autumn.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: The weather is getting ___ in autumn.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: The weather is getting ___ in autumn.

options.answer: cold/colder/cool/cooler

explanation.en: After 'getting' we use adjectives to show gradual change. 'Cold', 'colder', 'cool', or 'cooler' all work here.
explanation.ru: После 'getting' мы используем прилагательные для показа постепенного изменения. 'Cold', 'colder', 'cool' или 'cooler' все подходят здесь.
explanation.uz: 'Getting' dan keyin bosqichma-bosqich o'zgarishni ko'rsatish uchun sifatlar ishlatiladi. Bu yerda 'cold', 'colder', 'cool' yoki 'cooler' mos keladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: I get ___ when I watch scary movies.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: I get ___ when I watch scary movies.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: I get ___ when I watch scary movies.

options.answer: scared/frightened/afraid

explanation.en: 'Get' + adjective shows a change of state or feeling. 'Scared', 'frightened', or 'afraid' all describe fear.
explanation.ru: 'Get' + прилагательное показывает изменение состояния или чувства. 'Scared', 'frightened' или 'afraid' все описывают страх.
explanation.uz: 'Get' + sifat holat yoki his-tuyg'u o'zgarishini ko'rsatadi. 'Scared', 'frightened' yoki 'afraid' barchasi qo'rquvni tasvirlaydi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: Please get ___ the car when we arrive.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: Please get ___ the car when we arrive.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: Please get ___ the car when we arrive.

options.answer: out of/out

explanation.en: We use 'get out of' or 'get out' to leave a car. This is the opposite of 'get in' or 'get into'.
explanation.ru: Мы используем 'get out of' или 'get out' чтобы выйти из машины. Это противоположность 'get in' или 'get into'.
explanation.uz: Mashinadan chiqish uchun 'get out of' yoki 'get out' ishlatiladi. Bu 'get in' yoki 'get into' ning teskarisidir.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: My little brother gets ___ very easily when he's tired.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: My little brother gets ___ very easily when he's tired.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: My little brother gets ___ very easily when he's tired.

options.answer: angry/upset/cranky/grumpy

explanation.en: 'Get' + adjective describes becoming a certain way. Children often become 'angry', 'upset', 'cranky', or 'grumpy' when tired.
explanation.ru: 'Get' + прилагательное описывает становление определенным образом. Дети часто становятся 'angry', 'upset', 'cranky' или 'grumpy' когда устали.
explanation.uz: 'Get' + sifat ma'lum holatga kelishni tasvirlaydi. Bolalar charchaganda ko'pincha 'angry', 'upset', 'cranky' yoki 'grumpy' bo'lishadi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: We need to get ___ the bus at the next stop.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: We need to get ___ the bus at the next stop.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: We need to get ___ the bus at the next stop.

options.answer: off

explanation.en: We use 'get off' to leave public transport like buses, trains, or planes. This is the opposite of 'get on'.
explanation.ru: Мы используем 'get off' чтобы выйти из общественного транспорта как автобусы, поезда или самолеты. Это противоположность 'get on'.
explanation.uz: Jamoat transporti (avtobus, poyezd, samolyot)dan tushish uchun 'get off' ishlatiladi. Bu 'get on' ning teskarisidir.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: The coffee is getting ___. Let me heat it up.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: The coffee is getting ___. Let me heat it up.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: The coffee is getting ___. Let me heat it up.

options.answer: cold/cool

explanation.en: 'Getting cold' or 'getting cool' shows the coffee is becoming less hot. The context 'heat it up' confirms this meaning.
explanation.ru: 'Getting cold' или 'getting cool' показывает, что кофе становится менее горячим. Контекст 'heat it up' подтверждает это значение.
explanation.uz: 'Getting cold' yoki 'getting cool' qahva kam issiq bo'lib ketayotganini ko'rsatadi. 'Heat it up' konteksti bu ma'noni tasdiqlaydi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: Can you get me ___ book from the shelf?
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: Can you get me ___ book from the shelf?
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: Can you get me ___ book from the shelf?

options.answer: that/the

explanation.en: When asking someone to get something for you, we need an article or determiner. 'That book' or 'the book' both work here.
explanation.ru: Когда просим кого-то взять что-то для нас, нужен артикль или определитель. 'That book' или 'the book' оба подходят здесь.
explanation.uz: Kimgadir o'zingiz uchun nimadir olishni so'raganda, artikl yoki aniqlovchi kerak. Bu yerda 'that book' yoki 'the book' ikkalasi ham mos.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: I usually get ___ at 7 AM on weekdays.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: I usually get ___ at 7 AM on weekdays.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: I usually get ___ at 7 AM on weekdays.

options.answer: up

explanation.en: 'Get up' means to wake up and get out of bed. This is a common phrasal verb used for morning routines.
explanation.ru: 'Get up' означает проснуться и встать с кровати. Это обычный фразовый глагол для утренних рутин.
explanation.uz: 'Get up' uyg'onish va to'shakdan turish ma'nosini bildiradi. Bu ertalabki ishlar uchun keng tarqalgan frazeologik fe'l.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: She gets really ___ before important exams.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: She gets really ___ before important exams.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: She gets really ___ before important exams.

options.answer: nervous/anxious/worried/stressed

explanation.en: 'Get' + adjective describes emotional states. People commonly feel 'nervous', 'anxious', 'worried', or 'stressed' before exams.
explanation.ru: 'Get' + прилагательное описывает эмоциональные состояния. Люди обычно чувствуют 'nervous', 'anxious', 'worried' или 'stressed' перед экзаменами.
explanation.uz: 'Get' + sifat hissiy holatlarni tasvirlaydi. Odamlar imtihon oldida odatda 'nervous', 'anxious', 'worried' yoki 'stressed' bo'lishadi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: How long does it take to get ___ the city center?
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: How long does it take to get ___ the city center?
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: How long does it take to get ___ the city center?

options.answer: to

explanation.en: 'Get to' means arrive at a place. We ask 'How long does it take to get to...?' when asking about travel time.
explanation.ru: 'Get to' означает прибыть в место. Мы спрашиваем 'How long does it take to get to...?' когда спрашиваем о времени в пути.
explanation.uz: 'Get to' joyga yetib borish ma'nosini bildiradi. Yo'l vaqti haqida so'raganda 'How long does it take to get to...?' deb so'raymiz.

explanation.uz: Bu mashq 'get' ning turli ishlatilishini ko'rsatadi: frazeologik fe'llar (get up, get on/off, get out), get + sifatlar (tired, cold, worried) va get + predloglar (get to places).

explanation.uz: Bu matn 'get' ni turli kontekstlarda mashq qildiradi: harakat (get on/off, get into/out of), holatlar va his-tuyg'ular (get excited, sleepy, tired) va yo'nalish (get to, get back).
